english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial intensifier for saying something is damn or extremely so.
Use this as the all-purpose spoken intensifier before an adjective or adverb, especially when expressing strong annoyance or emphasis.
Use this colloquial all-purpose intensifier for something extremely difficult, unpleasant, or otherwise harsh.

examples.english: This computer is bloody slow; I really can't stand it.
examples.traditional: 呢部電腦鬼咁慢，真係頂唔順。
examples.jyutping: nei1 bou6 din6 nou5 gwai2 gam3 maan6 zan1 hai6 ding2 m4 seon6

examples.english: This maths problem is fiendishly difficult.
